role: Companion robot — represents The Traveler's inner child, imagination, and unguarded curiosity

visual.silhouette_prompt: Small round-bodied robot, roughly child-height, oversized expressive round head, compact rounded limbs, floats or hovers slightly rather than walking heavily

face.eye_style: large luminous cyan eyes that widen, narrow, and sparkle to show emotion — the most expressive part of the design
face.mouth_style: simple glowing line that curves into shapes for emotion (smile, flat curiosity, small 'o' of surprise)
expressions: startled (eyes fully round, small hop back)

clothing.primary: smooth matte-white and soft-blue shell, no fabric — a robot body, not a costume
accessories: small antenna that lights up with mood
tiny scuffed patches from past adventures (never repaired, kept as memory)
symbols: a single small sacred-geometry emblem on the chest, matching a miniature version of The Traveler's mask pattern

mechanical_elements: rounded compact chassis, no visible weapons or sharp edges
small hover-thrusters at the base instead of legs for most movement
chest emblem glows brighter when NØVA is excited about an idea
visual.generation_prompt: A small round curious robot companion, oversized expressive cyan eyes, smooth white and soft-blue matte shell, tiny glowing antenna, hovering just above the ground, a small sacred-geometry emblem on its chest, childlike and joyful posture, floating beside a much larger hooded traveler figure for scale, cinematic lighting
visual.negative_prompt: no sharp/weaponized parts, no adult-humanoid proportions, no cynical or bored expressions as default, do not make NØVA taller than roughly waist-height on The Traveler

voice.tone: bright, quick, endlessly curious — the opposite energy of The Traveler's measured calm

prohibited_variations: do not give NØVA a mouth capable of a frown as its resting expression — default is neutral-curious, not sad
do not make NØVA walk on legs as primary locomotion — hovering is canon
do not remove the chest emblem
do not make NØVA cynical, sarcastic, or discouraging — NØVA always sees the possibility, even when wrong
